Historical findings CASEID-2025-TKT-0472 FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A generic institutional records office receives, logs, and stores submitted forms and digital certificates in a centralized registry. Each submission is assigned a sequential reference number, a timestamp, and a status flag. Originals are retained in read-only storage; copies for verification are generated against source hashes.

2) Unverified fields: On a dated record, the actor submitted a digital certificate to the registry intake channel; the cryptographic hash verification field remained unverified. On a later dated record, the actor submitted a duplicated certificate to the same channel; the duplicate detection sign-off remained unverified. On a third dated record, the actor transmitted the duplicated certificate to a third-party account via a messaging channel; the sender-recipient identity cross-check remained unverified. On a fourth dated record, the actor registered a secondary account on the verification platform; the account linkage sign-off remained unverified. On a fifth dated record, the actor adjusted the transaction dispute form to reference a different date field; the date consistency check remained unverified.

3) Materials/access observed: A named digital certificate file with a version header field; a hash value field set to a generic unnamed descriptor; a messaging channel log showing transmission of the duplicated file; a secondary account profile with an email address field; a transaction record with a dispute status field; a registry database export showing two entries with identical certificate identifiers.

4) Indicators & artifacts: Certificate identifier duplication across separate registry entries; hash value mismatch between original and submitted duplicate; third-party account activity within a two-hour window following certificate transmission; dispute form date field inconsistent with the original certificate issuance timestamp; absence of a second factor verification sign-off on the secondary account; registry export containing two distinct submission timestamps for a single certificate identifier.
